"provider_id" TEXT NOT NULL,

CONSTRAINT "ai_provider_calls_purpose_check" CHECK (((purpose) IN ('assistant', 'writing', 'speaking', 'test'))))

CREATE TABLE "ai_provider_rotation" ("priority" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("priority" IS NULL OR (typeof("priority")='integer')) CHECK("priority" IS NULL OR ("priority" BETWEEN -2147483648 AND 2147483647)),
"purpose" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("purpose" IS NULL OR (length("purpose")<=16)),

CONSTRAINT "ai_provider_routing_hedge_delay_ms_check" CHECK (((hedge_delay_ms >= 0) AND (hedge_delay_ms <= 10000))),

"name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("name" IS NULL OR (length("name")<=120)),
"endpoint" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("endpoint" IS NULL OR (length("endpoint")<=1000)),

"is_correct" INTEGER CHECK("is_correct" IS NULL OR ("is_correct" IN(0,1))),

CONSTRAINT "attempt_answers_points_valid" CHECK (((points_awarded IS NULL) OR (points_awarded >= 0))))

CREATE TABLE "attempts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL,
"user_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
"material_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("material_type" IS NULL OR (length("material_type")<=16)),
"material_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
"material_version_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
"status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ('IN_PROGRESS') CHECK("status" IS NULL OR (length("status")<=16)),
"score" INTEGER CHECK("score" IS NULL OR (typeof("score")='integer')) CHECK("score" IS NULL OR ("score" BETWEEN -32768 AND 32767)),

CONSTRAINT "attempts_band_valid" CHECK (((band IS NULL) OR (((band >= (0)) AND (band <= (9))) AND ((band * (2)) = trunc((band * (2))))))),

CONSTRAINT "attempts_pkey" PRIMARY KEY (id),
CONSTRAINT "attempts_score_valid" CHECK (((score IS NULL) OR ((max_score IS NOT NULL) AND ((score >= 0) AND (score <= max_score))))),

CONSTRAINT "attempts_user_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)

"mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("mime_type" IS NULL OR (length("mime_type")<=100)),

CONSTRAINT "blog_media_uploaded_by_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (uploaded_by) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL)

"slug" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("slug" IS NULL OR (length("slug")<=255)),
"title" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("title" IS NULL OR (length("title")<=300)),
"description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (''),

CONSTRAINT "listening_versions_number_valid" CHECK ((version_number > 0)),

CONSTRAINT "listening_versions_test_number_unique" UNIQUE (test_id, version_number),
